data.spec: Facility implementation provides POST /api/facility/readings {event_id,board_id:'kitchen'|'bathroom'|'printer',metric,value,timestamp,simulation:false for physical samples}. Known canonical metrics co2_ppm,temperature_c,humidity_pct,stock_level,bin_fill_pct,obstruction_mm,noise_level,tilt_deg,heartbeat. /api/sensor {board_id,kind,value,event_id?,timestamp?,simulation?} delegates known aliases co2/co2_ppm,temperature/th_temperature/temperature_c,humidity/th_humidity/humidity_pct,stock_level etc. /api/telemetry compatible {key,value,board_id?:default kitchen,event_id?,timestamp?,simulation?:false} will accept CO2/temp/humidity and calibrated canonical metrics, raw distance stored without inferring item stock. GET /api/air-quality returns {level,readings,updated_at}. User says CO2 module added. Hardware owner should forward physical samples; this task won't change bridge firmware or steal hardware ownership.
